system.description: Creation requires removing a leg bone from a living donor (who must initially survive), submerging it in molten lead inscribed with runes, then beating the donor to death with the bone while chanting. A successful ritual roll produces a "devil stick": anyone holding it can spend a Willpower Trait to activate it for a scene, during which it deals an extra, aggravated die of damage to zombies/animate dead and drains a point from the Passion Pool of any wraith it strikes. Carrying an active or even inactive devil-stick imposes a one-Trait penalty on all attempts to summon or compel ghosts, as spirits sense and avoid it.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
